ttd.name: Olifant TTD
ttd.authority: Main ruled the South Africa line on 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day: the TTD (Project Loggim's one Tank Technology Demonstrator, 1992) as the South African special at tier III (IV ruled, III by its same-tier duels). Kevin, 2026-11-21: "make the ttd its own tank instead of being based off of the leopard 2" (lane ttd-275, superseding the 11-02 "based on an actual leopard 2"): a first-party build on its own construction from the photographs and D. Bocquelet's side elevation; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
ttd.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope of the TTD's own construction (ttd-275): TE's 7.78 x 3.62 m hull as the elevation draws it (scaled at 77.8 px/m: 9.40 m over the gun, 0.70 m road wheels at 0.83 m), 3.66 m over the skirts' joint bosses, 9.45 m from the rear hooks to the muzzle reference unit (TE 9.41 m), the turret roof at 2.52 m and the CS60N head at 2.80 m (TE's 2.99 m is reached by no photographed part); the tallest point is the whips' tips. The envelope holds the loader's FN MAG and the whips.
